quotes.author: devon jones
quotes.text: Our family had a wonderful time fishing for walleye with Lake Erie Fishing Adventures! Captain Mike was phenomenal. He was friendly, incredibly knowledgeable, and worked hard to make sure we had a successful and enjoyable day on the water. His experience and passion for fishing really showed throughout the trip. We made great memories together and absolutely plan to come back for another adventure in the future. Highly recommend!

quotes.author: Erin Leupp
quotes.text: We had an absolute blast on our family fishing trip. Captain Mike was the best we could ask for — he made the trip so enjoyable from the second we stepped on the boat. Whether you’re an experienced fisherman, or just looking to have some fun, Captain Mike won’t steer you wrong! We cannot recommend him enough!

quotes.author: P L
quotes.text: Captain Mike took great care of our family of 5. We limited out quickly. He kept in close contact a day in advance with weather alerts, suggesting an earlier departure to beat the wind and chop. A perfect day on the water. We will definitely return!

quotes.author: Amy Freitag
quotes.text: Captain Larry was EXCELLENT. We caught tons of fish and he is super knowledgeable. He was equally great with a 17 year old and a 65+ year old. Highly recommend!!!

quotes.author: Todd Dietrich
quotes.text: Captain Larry is the best! It was a challenging day on the lake and he kept changing things up until we got out limit. Wonderful trip.

quotes.author: Brandon Henderson
quotes.text: Captain Larry was awesome and taught us a lot while we were fishing. 10/10 fishing experience
